decisions.reason: A spring-controlled flap weir builds directly on the firm's core hydraulic steel engineering and weir know-how from thousands of projects, so it can readily interpret field results and refine the product.

An energy management system for water facilities extends the firm's automation software and control modules and fits its strategic direction toward networked, energy-efficient infrastructure, giving it strong absorptive capacity to develop it further.

The overflow flap gate line with several models and its own dedicated page sits squarely in the firm's established flood-control and water-level regulation expertise, making it a well-understood product the firm can learn from and improve.
